defaults.controller_layout: cross = key:space;circle = key:c;square = key:r;triangle = key:f;l1 = mouse:wheel_up;r1 = mouse:wheel_down;l2 = key:z;r2 = mouse:left;l3 = key:shift;r3 = none;up = key:1;right = key:2;down = key:3;left = key:4;options = key:escape;create = key:tab;touchpad_left = key:f5;touchpad_right = key:f9;left_stick = keys;left_stick_keys = w,s,a,d;right_stick = mouse

community.title: WASD and mouse layout
community.notes: Keys match DOOM 3's default binds: left stick WASD, right stick looks, R2 fires (and clicks in-game screens), L2 zoom, Cross jump, Circle crouch, Square reload, Triangle flashlight, L1/R1 previous/next weapon, L3 run, D-pad weapons 1-4, Options menu, Create PDA, touchpad left/right quicksave/quickload. The game needs a Playden that unpacks its SteamStub and writes its Steam CD key; without them it doesn't start or stops at a CD Key box.
community.author: argrento
